What is happening here—and where am I in all this?

A short, approachable guide for people who are still looking for words for what they are living through.

What the guide offers

  • a way to separate observable facts from fear and assumptions;
  • one simple exercise for taking stock of your situation;
  • a preview of the full workbook’s approach;
  • permission to begin without making a major decision today.

Move at your own pace. If an exercise brings up more than you can hold alone, pause and reach out to someone you trust or a qualified professional.
